referenceImageInspection.method: Each original PNG was opened with tools.view_image in named groups and manually viewed. No contact-sheet-only or automated pass-count claim is used.

groups.notes: Topology overview only; full individual references inspected separately.
Manually viewed all 17 default product images. Reader defaults show menus; PW source has no dock, while SC manager keeps the dock. SC manga has a visibly narrower left information column.

PW library More is a top-right float; sort and queue replace the lower screen with white full-width sheets; selection hides continuation and replaces dock; jump is a single row of six centered folio choices.

SC More and sort are top-right floats; queue is centered; selection retains both continuation/update cards and replaces dock; jump is full-width above folio. The SC sort reference only shows eight choices and Done, whereas HANDOFF requires direction and filters too.

PW detail page two collapses information to a compact book title and twelve chapter rows, preserving an eight-page total for 86 records. Description, batch download, and tracking are bottom sheets. Linked account/progress in the export is illustrative; unavailable integration must be explicit.

SC detail uses anchored More and centered tracking/migration floats, white backgrounds without dimming. Migration separates a radio candidate list from three retention/removal toggles and equal Cancel/Start actions.

PW source management uses in-place tabs, language filters, outlined per-row install/update, and a wide bulk update action. Add source and source list controls are bottom sheets. QR/local IP waiting examples must never imply a running endpoint without actual service support.

Filters have four order choices, multiple publication states, twelve tag chips with tri-state semantics, Reset, and a wide results action. PW panels attach to the bottom; SC panels float near header triggers. Source settings use declared language/quality controls.

SC source picker is a bounded grouped float with current checkmark and management footer actions. Unconfigured server and verification-blocked sources replace the catalog content while preserving top-level dock. Setup has labeled fields and two equal actions; blocked state has migration and uninstall.
SC source updates affect only the right column; installed sources remain stable on the left. Add/list panels float at the same upper-center location; all background content remains undimmed.

Numeric PW keyboard retains candidate strip but changes letter keys to numbers/symbols. Search results restore the dock, group records by source with separate no-results and timeout/retry rows, and show up to three PW or six SC covers per source.

Updates switch the main heading and expose bulk download while preserving per-row queued/download states. Incognito uses a full-width inverted status bar and pressed header action. Clear dialogs are outlined white with two equal actions and no dimming.

PW settings page two omits the device card and has nine grouped rows; secondary pages keep the dock but omit list pager. Display has five refresh choices, three quality cards, three switches, and sixteen grayscale cells. Power has three screensaver thumbnails. SC light/pen are capability-dependent.

All SC settings retain the same 320-design-pixel navigation column and active black row. Storage is a stacked usage bar with separate legend and targeted management actions. Reading is four equal directions. Tap-zone radio cards include diagrams and two switches. Image treatment has five contrast choices plus crop/dither/split.

Spread has three orientation layouts, two spread treatments, and separate-cover switch. Categories have inline Rename with an immutable Uncategorized row and dashed Add. Automatic updates use a three-way frequency plus three conditions. Source lists include manage/add/remove. Downloads show four prefetch choices and actual destination.

Tracking authorizes inside the account card, showing QR/code/pending and cancel rather than a modal. The export's authorization simulation button is explicitly excluded. Backup has two actions and a dated list; language uses a trailing checkmark; logs have one switch and two actions; About is concise data rows.

Closed PW reference has a bookmark ribbon, and footer variant adds white-backed chapter/progress labels; both decorations and the invisible footer-cycle hit region are overridden by the user's pure-artwork decision. ToC is a five-row sheet above menu chrome. Mode has four direction cards, three layouts, and crop/split toggles.

PW reader picture uses a preview with contrast stepper, five refresh intervals, dither and night controls. Light has two 0..24 sliders; manual direction has portrait/landscape/reverse-landscape cards. More includes footer setting in export but the closed-reader result remains pure artwork under the user override.

SC portrait closed artwork uses edge-to-edge canvas and the export's ribbon; its footer variant is a centered page label in a white lower art margin. These decorations are overridden. Portrait ToC is two-column and mode has four cards with crop/split toggles side by side, without PW layout row.

SC picture is horizontal preview/contrast/refresh with dither status and night toggle to the right. Light presents brightness and warmth side by side with auto below. Orientation has portrait/spread/follow cards; prototype-only preview link is excluded. More is two columns with manual refresh.

Landscape uses two equal page allocations with no decorative seam, and ribbon is overridden. Header adds orientation lock; page progress is a range. Tools replace direction with layout. ToC/mode/layout panels use generous 120-design-pixel side insets.

Landscape picture/light/more preserve wide side insets, compact stacked menu controls, explicit current tab, and undimmed artwork. Frontlight/warmth/auto brightness are only truthful where capabilities exist.

Viewed all four component references and the options board. Adopted option B is the folio pager with text navigation and central current/total, no enclosing rule. Options A/C remain rejected alternatives, not routes. Cover art is an illustrative halftone placeholder.

Viewed both full specification boards. The book-page hierarchy, eight-color UI palette, no scroll/animation/shadows/dimming, folio pagination, target dimensions, refresh scheduling and gestures align with HANDOFF. Reader ribbon/footer/cycle instructions are overridden only for the closed reader.

Grouped chronology, real timestamps/progress, entry deletion/clear confirmation, empty result, global incognito status/persistence and updates queue states.
Review all 18 sections where applicable, not only screenshot-exported PW pages; every enabled control has a concrete operation or truthful unavailable state.
Frontlight/warmth/sensor/dither/pen missing-capability variants hide dependent controls; no fabricated connected, authorized, logged-in or completed state.
Empty, long title/description, dense categories/sources, offline and timeout states remain paginated and readable without overlap.
